title: Fed holds rates steady but signals two cuts later this year as inflation cools
summary: The Federal Reserve kept its benchmark rate unchanged and projected two quarter-point cuts in 2026, citing easing price pressures and a resilient labor market.

title: S&P 500 hits record high as megacap tech rallies on AI demand
summary: U.S. stocks surged to fresh records, led by semiconductor and cloud names, as investors bet that AI capital spending will keep driving earnings growth.

title: Bitcoin tops $90,000 as spot ETF inflows accelerate
summary: The largest cryptocurrency jumped past $90,000 amid record inflows into U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs and growing institutional adoption.

title: Oil prices plunge 4% on surprise build in U.S. crude inventories
summary: Brent and WTI crude tumbled after government data showed an unexpected jump in stockpiles, raising concerns about softening global demand.

title: Dollar slips against yen after Bank of Japan signals policy shift
summary: The U.S. dollar weakened versus the Japanese yen as the BOJ hinted at further normalization, narrowing the rate gap between the two economies.

title: Nvidia beats earnings estimates, guides higher on data-center demand
summary: The chipmaker reported record quarterly revenue and raised its outlook, fueled by relentless demand for AI accelerators from cloud providers.

title: Gold climbs to all-time high as investors seek safe havens
summary: Bullion rallied to a record amid geopolitical tensions and expectations of looser monetary policy, with central-bank buying adding support.

title: Eurozone inflation eases to 2.1%, bolstering case for ECB rate cut
summary: Consumer price growth in the euro area slowed more than expected, strengthening market bets that the European Central Bank will lower rates next month.
